response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development and leadership roles, but his background is heavily skewed towards web/mobile development (Node.js, TypeScript, React) and scripting languages (D, Python), with limited recent experience in C++ for industrial automation or on-premises/cloud platform solutions. While he has some C++ experience (National Instruments, LabWindows/CVI), it is not recent or central to his career. His strengths in scalable systems, architectural design, and secure development practices are evident but not directly aligned with the C++-focused requirements of this role.
strengths: Strong background in scalable systems and high-performance development (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests at Dunnhumby)
Proven leadership and mentorship experience (e.g., organizing Refactoring Dojos, mentoring teams at Altom Consulting)
Experience with secure development practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development at RIDE Capital)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last clear C++ role was 2014–2015, with no recent C++ projects in his portfolio)
No direct experience with industrial automation protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, OPC UA) or IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards
Cloud experience is primarily AWS/CDK (Optilyz) and Kubernetes (GISCollective), with no mention of Microsoft Azure

key_factors.factor: Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 compliance
